description: This source file contains test cases for the NodeAppModel in the openclaw project. It defines various unit tests for functionalities such as deep linking, notification handling, watch messaging, canvas commands, and other app behaviors. The file also includes mock classes for testing external dependencies like watch messaging and notification center, and tests are structured using a test suite with multiple individual test cases.
